purpose: Let APD admins edit a campaign student's category, an empty Program User ID, and free-text registration data (school name, study major, student identity number) through one ParticipantUpdate aggregate; the participant update event records previous values.
acceptance_criteria: Only admins can update a participant of the campaign; participants outside the campaign are rejected (PARTICIPANT_NOT_FOUND).
Category must belong to the campaign (CATEGORY_NOT_IN_CAMPAIGN) and cannot be cleared.
Program User ID can be filled from empty but not changed from X to Y (PROGRAM_USER_ID_ALREADY_SET), and must be unique within the campaign (PROGRAM_USER_ID_ALREADY_USED); values are trimmed.

Registration fields are editable only when the participant has registration data (REGISTRATION_NOT_FOUND) and the field exists for the program (REGISTRATION_FIELD_NOT_AVAILABLE); values cannot be emptied.
ParticipantWasUpdated is shared by CSV import and manual edit and carries previous_* values in eventData.
Translations exist in id and en.
